name: affinity-photo-new
description: Streamline photo editing, retouching, and creative workflows with this Affinity Photo 2 toolkit.

paragraphs: affinity-photo-new is a free, powerful bridge that connects Google's artificial intelligence (Gemini) directly to your Serif Affinity apps—Affinity Photo, Affinity Designer, and Affinity Publisher. With this tool, you can generate vector graphics, automate canvas tasks, and create designs programmatically—all without writing a single line of code.
Think of it as your personal AI design assistant that works right inside your favorite Affinity software.
features: Describe what you want (e.g., "a minimalist mountain logo") and watch Gemini create it instantly as a vector graphic in Affinity.
Automate repetitive tasks like resizing layers, applying filters, or arranging elements—all controlled through simple commands.
Let AI handle tedious work like batch-processing images, organizing layers, or generating layout variations while you focus on creativity.
If you use AI coding tools (like Cursor or VS Code Copilot), this server lets them talk to Affinity directly, enabling advanced automation workflows.
